Definition: a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael
BiblicalUsage: Yisrᵉʼêlîy means a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael. In Leviticus 24:10 we read, "And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel..." It appears again in 2 Samuel 17:25: "And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son..."
TheologicalSignificance: Yisre'eliy is a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael, and what I take from it is that God speaks plainly, so I should listen plainly too.
